name: tabs
summary: A row or column of tabs that switches which panel of content shows in place, with a line that slides to the selected tab.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Names the tab list for screen readers; not shown, since the tabs' own labels are the visible text.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Horizontal puts the tabs in a row above the panel; vertical in a column beside it. Where the screen is narrow it stays a row.

slots.name: items
slots.description: The tabs, in order: a value, one short label, and whether it is disabled.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: The content of the selected tab.

events.name: change
events.description: The selected tab changed, with its value.

states.name: rest
states.description: Unselected tabs in the muted foreground; the selected tab in the foreground with the line under it (beside it when vertical).

states.name: focused
states.description: A ring around the focused tab.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The tab scales to the press scale, never under reduced motion.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A disabled tab is faded and can't be pressed.

accessibility.name: Its label names the tab list; each tab by its label, the selected one marked selected.
accessibility.keyboard: One tab stop for the list, on the selected tab; the arrow keys that follow the orientation move to the next enabled tab and select it; Home and End go to the first and last.
accessibility.web: A role="tablist" named by its label, of role="tab" elements with aria-selected, each with aria-controls to its role="tabpanel", which aria-labelledby names by its tab (WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices tabs pattern); aria-orientation when vertical.
accessibility.apple: A container named by its label, of buttons with the selected trait on the selected tab; the panel follows the list. SwiftUI has no tab-list role.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Tab with the Selection pattern, of ControlType.TabItem elements with SelectionItem, named by their labels; the panel is ControlType.Pane.
accessibility.android: A selectableGroup container named by its label, of Role.Tab nodes with the selected state and a click action, named by their labels.

cases.person: Two tabs in a row, Ingredients in the foreground with a line under it and Method muted, and the ingredient list below.
Two tabs stacked in a column, Profile selected with the line beside it and Billing faded.

deviations: Web's items may instead each be a link to a page of its own (href, currentPath), rendered as a nav of links; native kits have panels only, and a page's own navigation uses TabBar or Sidebar.
Web also takes activation (automatic or manual); native tabs always select on press.
Tabs are buttons with the selected trait, as SwiftUI has no tab-list role.
Drawn as a templated control on WinUI's TabView or Pivot semantics without its close and add buttons, which web's Tabs has no equivalent for.
Drawn rather than Material's TabRow, whose indicator and heights differ; its tabs carry Role.Tab as TabRow's do.
